verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop agent-orchestration app, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The developer's note that messages run through the local Claude Code installation is about message routing, not an opt-out control. Community comments also flag that the vendor discloses nothing about its data practices.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
